notes: Windows: the crew now has Buddy's own shape. Every other AI agent on screen is a pointer in the shape you picked in Settings, Look. Its colour and its name tell it from Buddy, and when you change Buddy's shape the crew follows.
Buddy asks first. It looks for OpenCode, Claude Code and Codex on your PC and asks before it shows any of them. 1.7.0 showed them without asking, so after this update Buddy asks once.
Agents window: Settings, Buddy (AI), Agents. Tick the agents to show, scan again, or add your own AI.
Your own AI: give it a name, a colour and the command that starts it. Then "@name question" in the ask box starts it and shows its pointer until the program ends.
Team names: a tool that starts sessions in another agent can give each session its own name on the pointer (README, "Crew"). The OpenBot bridge uses this.
Fixed: a colour you picked for one agent is no longer handed to another agent.
Not checked: Claude Code and Codex with a live session (recorded samples only), and a real third-party AI product as your own AI (a stand-in program was used).
